# Verifies initial-sync of declarative bindings: text(value=name) where
# name="World" produces a span whose textContent is seeded by the script
# without user interaction.
#
# Phase 2 pipeline (g.updates rip) emits:
#   - state object: let state = {name: "World"};
#   - single __sngl_init() with the inlined DOM write
#   - immediate invocation of __sngl_init() at script bottom
# Init-only updaters no longer get per-prop $u_* function emissions.

sngl compile --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# State initialization with the var's initial value.
grep 'state = {name: "World"}' out/index.html

# No per-node init-only updater function — write inlined into __sngl_init.
! grep '\$u__n0_text' out/index.html
grep '__n0.textContent = state.name' out/index.html

# Single init function defined and called at bootstrap.
grep 'function __sngl_init' out/index.html
grep '__sngl_init\(\);' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
output { none { html } }

component main {
    var name = "World"
    text(value=name)
}
